_about: Ambient events of BeamNG.drive 0.40.0.0 (build 287428), read on 2026-10-20 from an installed game (not with --scan: in 0.40 the strings bank stores the paths as a prefix trie, so the plain scan finds none). Source: art/sound/fmod/desktop/main_preload.strings.bank in content/art_sound.zip (the only strings bank; desktop_headphones has the same list), the Ambient subtree rebuilt from the trie in order, and the SFXEmitter tracks of all 1278 levels/*.level.json (only the 6 West Coast ones are Ambient). Seen verbatim: the West Coast events and Water>River (also the editor's default river event); the others are rebuilt from the trie. No Environment events, and no church bell, bird, cricket or insect events in 0.40 (the editor names Ambient>Ambiences>Forest_Static and >Roomtone, which are not in this strings bank).
